aggregation_method: Median/min/max of JVM p50 values, retaining every trial. Within-JVM p50/p95/p99 use nearest-rank and remain with raw frame samples; frames are never pooled across JVMs. Paired ratios use current/baseline from the same trial, including ratios above one.
phase_method: Measured sample index modulo 2: Gaussian radii 7/11 and bloom iterations 2/3. Phase p50 is nearest-rank within each JVM, then median/min/max across JVMs. Mixed overall distributions are also retained.
timing_gate: None: timings are evidence, not a noisy pass/fail speed threshold
coverage: Pbuffer/FBO, actual shaders/fonts, two viewport/GUI scales; excludes native Display, worlds, shaderpacks and game FPS

first_pair_budget_estimate.scope: Linear planning estimate; excludes CI setup, baseline compilation, current contracts, CPU font probes and artifact upload. Workflow limit remains 25 minutes.

_provenance.source_preservation: Every field and value in the original comparison.json is retained. Only _provenance and clearly separated _supplementary_evidence were added; whitespace is compacted.
_provenance.statistical_scope: Within-JVM p50/p95/p99 use nearest rank. Four JVM p50 values are summarized using their ordinary median and min/max, with all paired current/baseline ratios retained. Gaussian and bloom phases use the original sample index modulo 2. Timings are software-Mesa synthetic scenes, not game FPS or client/world startup.

_supplementary_evidence.font_probe_scope: One additional JVM per revision, separate from four native rendering pairs. Preserve both slower churn/long-text results. Original command line omitted from excerpts; full source log hash retained.

derived_tail_analysis.method: Original raw completed_ms samples; phase slices before nearest-rank quantiles. 45 samples per phase, p99=max; 90 overall, p99=max. Thresholds descriptive post-hoc diagnostics, same baseline-derived threshold within each pair. No exclusion or speed gate.
